verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Shopify pushes order-state webhooks to a registered endpoint, but this is one-directional event notification, not a mechanism for an AI-native user to author custom rules ('when X happens, do Y automatically'). Webhook subscription itself isn't even self-serve ('contact your Shopify partner manager'), and there is no documented rules/automation engine (e.g., Shopify Flow-style triggers) exposed to UCP agents.
